title: CPSC, Four Seasons and Cardinal IG Co. Announce Recall to Repair Sunroom Roof Glass
summary: Sunlight reflecting off certain sunroom roof glass and skylights onto adjacent cedar shingles or cedar shakes could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 6,000 Sunrooms.

title: Ace Han Baby Walkers Recalled Due to Stairway Fall Hazard
summary: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed. Units: About 2,500.

title: Bike Pro Inc. Reannounces Baby Walker Recall Due to Stairway Fall Hazard
summary: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed. Units: About 50,000 (This recall was first announced in Oct. 2002).

title: CPSC, Weil-McLain Company Announce Recall of Boilers
summary: The blower assembly is not properly sealed. Gas can leak during operation and accumulate. If an ignition source is present, a fire or explosion could occur. Units: 1,131.

title: DESA Heating Products Recalls Portable Propane Convection Heaters
summary: The burners on these heaters can "flashback", which is when fire burns inside the burner tube rather than out the end. This can cause the lower portion of the burner tube to get hot enough to ignite combustible material under the heater. Units: About 54,500.

title: SunTome Reannounces Baby Walker Recall due to Stairway Fall Hazard
summary: The walkers can fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed. Units: About 600.

title: Polycom Inc. Recalls Conference Phone Batteries for Fire Hazard
summary: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire or burn hazard. Units: About 21,000 units in the U.S. (About 27,700 units worldwide).

title: CPSC, abc distributing, LLC. Announce Recall of Pilates Balls
summary: The plastic black clips at the end of the rubber tubing can come apart when in use. In addition, the grommet used to hold the black rubber tubing could separate from the nylon webbing. Consumers using the pilates balls could fall and be hit by pieces that separate. Units: About 8,300.

title: Black Dog Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled for Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 9,700.

title: Espresso Makers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The electrical connectors in the espresso machine can erode, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,100.

title: Paintball Markers Recalled for Ejecting CO2 Cartridges, Hits Users
summary: The carbon dioxide (CO2) cartridges can be forcibly ejected out the back of the paintball marker and break the plastic screw-on cap. title: Lasko Recalls Box and Pivoting Floor Fans Posing Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical failure in the motor can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 5.6 million.

title: CPSC, SFC America Announce Recall to Repair Fire Extinguishers
summary: The fire extinguishers can fail to discharge properly when the trigger is activated, which puts consumers at risk of fire-related injuries. Units: About 50,900.

title: CPSC, VSM Sewing Inc. Announce Recall of Sewing Machines
summary: Electrical arcing can occur in the machine's power supply, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 55,000.

title: Toy Mobile Phones Recalled for Choking Hazard
summary: The toy phone's yellow antenna can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. No injuries have been reported. Units: About 50,500.

title: Unilever Recalls Dove Facial Cleansing Massager after Nine Reports of Minor Injuries
summary: The cleansing pillows on this device can loosen or dislodge during use and then the SkinVitalizer can cause minor scratches to the skin. Units: About 438,000 units (about 50,000 of which have been purchased by consumers).

title: Next Marketing Inc. Recalls Youth Hooded Fleece with Drawstring for Strangulation Hazard
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 22,000.

title: Remote Control Flying Saucers Sold by QVC Recalled for Fire Hazard
summary: The battery charger cord sold with these flying saucers can overcharge and cause the toy to overheat, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 180,000.

title: Barbeques Galore Inc. Recalls Gas Grills Posing Risk of Gas Leaks, Fires
summary: The grills have faulty regulators that can release too much gas to the burner causing an excessive burner flame. This also poses a risk of gas leaks, fires and explosions if an ignition source is present. Units: About 1,800.

title: Chicken Limbo Party Games Recalled After 23 Reports of Injuries
summary: The game's two side poles do not fit into their bases properly, making the game unstable. This can cause the game to completely fall apart if touched, hitting children playing the game as well as bystanders. Units: About 461,000.

title: CPSC, Victoria's Secret Direct Announce Recall of Silk Kimono Tops
summary: The kimono tops are made of fabric that fails to meet mandatory standards of fabric flammability, in violation of the federal Flammable Fabrics Act. title: Metal Charms Recalled for Lead Poisoning Hazard to Children
summary: The recalled charms contain high levels of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning and adverse health effects to young children. Units: About 29,000.
